title: Enluminure
summary: Build a gilded initial letter on vellum: flood the letter with size, lay the gold leaf, paint the leaves in ultramarine, green and red, and finish with the pen tendrils.
howToPlay: The framed page shows the finished initial.
Tap each part of the letter to flood it with size, then press Gild.
Pick a colour and tap each leaf; then draw the numbered tendrils with the pen.
Press Check when it is finished.
rules: Score: how much of each shape holds the right colour, how closely your pen lines follow the guide, and a little for stroke order.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Watch and learn plays a whole round for you, and Undo takes back the last step.
heritageNote: Enluminure is the painting of manuscripts. An illuminator laid size on a large initial, pressed on gold leaf, painted leaves and berries in mineral colours, and finished the fine tendrils with the pen.
